input.prompt: Silhouette paper cutout animation, like a 1920s shadow-puppet fairy tale: everything is cut from black paper with intricate lace-like detail, set against glowing layered backgrounds of tinted translucent paper, deep blue fading to amber at the horizon. A tiny fisherman stands in a curled little boat on a lake of rippling paper waves, pulling a net out of the water; caught in the net is a glowing crescent moon. The sky above him is empty, no moon. Visible paper texture, delicate cut edges, soft light glowing through the paper layers.
